notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33100205/97ec212fe58793a2b53dc25bee8b83ab30c620ad.png[/img]

Hello!

The 1.0.1 update includes some changes to our sprites, as we cleaned some ghastly minor artifacts surrounding a few characters (even though it’s not Halloween) and had a few adjustments done to Liam’s uniform. Gregor also had his smile changed, increasing his chances to become a heartbreaker.

The Brazilian Portuguese version had lots of small corrections and minor revisions. Special thanks to Heinrich K. for his contribution.
